name: Should I address minor moisture issues before starting a basement remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I address minor moisture issues before starting a basement remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water management must always take priority over framing and drywall. Before hanging drywall or laying subflooring, any exterior grading issues, foundation cracks, or gutter drainage flaws must be repaired. Installing finished materials over untreated moisture leads to mold growth, ruined flooring, and structural rot behind wall cavities. If you notice dampness, musty odors, or efflorescence on concrete walls, you should consult a restoration specialist to test humidity levels and seal the foundation. Running a dedicated dehumidifier or waterproofing system ensures your new living space stays protected long term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, all foundation cracks, drainage problems, and water intrusion must be permanently resolved before framing or hanging drywall to avoid mold and structural damage.
